items.title: Replay Lincoln Park Closed By City For Safety Hazards, Code Violations Deemed A ‘Danger’
items.description: The arcade bar, known for its themed pop-ups, was ordered to stop operating after inspectors called it an "imminent and actual danger" and found it operating without a valid state liquor license.

items.title: Humboldt Park Coffee Shop Announces It’s Permanently Closed After Fallout Over ICE Allegations
items.description: Tasa Coffee Roasters closed Monday after workers walked off the job following viral allegations its owner's husband is an ICE agent. Amid protests, a "permanently closed" sign was placed in the storefront Tuesday.

items.title: Druski To Host Chicago’s Portion Of ‘Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve’ At Navy Pier
items.description: Free tickets to the nationally televised celebration will be released in two rounds at 10 a.m. Wednesday and Dec. 2.

items.title: Amtrak Scraps Bridgeport Rail Yard Plan, Throwing Sox Owner’s Plan For New Stadium Into Doubt
items.description: Amtrak’s decision to redevelop its 14th Street rail yard instead of building a facility in Bridgeport has dealt a blow to White Sox minority owner Justin Ishbia’s plan to move the team's stadium there.

items.title: U2 Announces September Concert At Soldier Field
items.description: U2 will play in Chicago as part of its first U.S. tour in years. Presale begins on Dec. 3.

items.title: Is Humboldt Park Coffee Shop Owned By ICE Agent? Workers Walk Off Job After Allegations Surface
items.description: Tasa Coffee Roasters’ owner has not addressed reports her husband is an ICE agent, and a man who called himself a relative flashed a gun at a Block Club reporter outside the shop.

items.title: Teamwork Englewood’s Empowerment Center A ‘Rebirth’ On 63rd Street
items.description: The $13 million project, which will break ground early next year, will transform a long-vacant building into a hub where the nonprofit offers more community services.

items.title: ‘Missing Middle’ Housing Program Breaks Ground On 3-Flats In Morgan Park
items.description: Five three-flat buildings are coming to vacant lots in Morgan Park as part of the city’s initiative to rebuild middle-class housing stock on the South and West sides.
